description: Describes JS-owned dirty/save state for a WYSIWYG editor instance.

members.name: DirtyEpoch
members.description: Monotonic runtime dirty epoch incremented when content changes.

members.name: IsDirty
members.description: Whether the JS runtime contains unsaved changes.

members.name: LastSavedAt
members.description: Timestamp reported by the JS runtime for the latest successful save.

members.name: LastSavedMarker
members.description: Provider marker associated with the latest successful save.

members.name: Reason
members.description: Reason for the latest dirty transition.

members.name: SavedEpoch
members.description: Dirty epoch that was last acknowledged as saved.

members.name: UndoEpoch
members.description: Undo epoch at the time this state was produced.
